57970.calculus: AP Calculus AB or BC is mandatory (either variant accepted), score >= 4
other_required: None required beyond Calculus; other APs may be any accepted subject (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Statistics, Computer Science A are only listed as accepted subjects, not required)
57970.free_choice_rule: At least 4 independent AP courses, of which Calculus AB or BC is mandatory; remaining APs from accepted list: Art history, English language and composition, English literature and composition, Comparative Government and Politics, European History, Human Geography, Macro-economics, Micro-economics, Psychology, US Government and Politics, US History, World History: Modern, Calculus AB or BC, Computer Science: A, Computer Science Principles, Statistics, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Physics and (all 7) World Languages and Cultures
57970.caps: "Only one AP can be a language course"; "World Languages and Cultures AP - will only be accepted as a 5th AP"; "By independent courses we refer to overlapping courses being counted as 1 AP" (e.g. US History + World History count as one; Micro + Macro economics count as one)
57970.min_score: "AP Calculus minimum score of 4 or higher, other AP's minimum score of 3 (scale 1-5)"; AP courses must be concluded with external College Board exam; min GPA 3.00 in grade 11 and 12 (international section); SAT/ACT not accepted; if AP Calculus requirement not met, a mathematics proficiency certificate (OMPT type D, Staatsexamen/Boswell-Beta/CCVX Wiskunde B) is needed
